review_description: Gedlec went out of business with outstanding work to do.
Gedlec are heads and shoulders above their competitors.  Service and quality like this is almost imposible to find now.

Gedlec were fantastic from the get go. Came to the house for a free consult and took pictures of the roof using a drone to help design the most efficient system they could whilst remaining aesthetically pleasing. Communication throughout the process was prompt and clear and all paperwork with power company and Solar Vic was handled without any hassle. Price was slightly higher than some others but installation was very professional with high quality components used. System is so far running perfectly a month later. Would absolutely recommend them to anyone.

The Gedlec team run as a well oiled and professional team. From the point of the first call, through to commissioning of the installed system, Gerard and his team were fantastic.Our house in Kew (Melbourne) has always been very probelmatic for solar panel installations - steep pitched roof with small terracotta shingles. I have been through more than ten installers to try and get quotes for a solar panel installation - virtually all turn the job down as too complicated or too risky.Gedlec saw the job as a challenge. Our 14.4kW array was not cheap due to the concitions of the install but the care and attention to detail that went into the workmanship was great.Gerard and his team were always welll mannaered and cheerful, on time, tidy. The grid was connected without issue and data flowing into the Enphase app.I'd highly recommend Gedlec to anyone especially if other installers have previously passed on your property due to potential installation issues
